curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: relate days of the week to various activities

mission.title: relate days of the week to various activities

interactions.prompt: The class raises the flag on Monday. Tap Monday.
interactions.feedback: Yes! The school flag is raised on Monday.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the day named in the sentence.

interactions.prompt: See the match: Monday goes with raising the flag. Now tap the day for the Friday flag parade.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the day that matches the activity.
interactions.feedback: Great matching! The flag parade is on Friday.
interactions.retryHint: Find the card that says Friday.

interactions.prompt: Match each activity to its day: school begins on Monday and family worship is on Sunday.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an activity, then tap its day.
interactions.feedback: Well done! You matched two activities to their days.
interactions.retryHint: Think about the first school day and the worship day.

interactions.prompt: Amina goes to football practice on Saturday. Which day should she choose?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Football practice is on Saturday.
interactions.retryHint: Say the activity sentence again. Which day did you hear?

interactions.prompt: Plan the class week. Match the activity cards to their days.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an activity card, then tap the matching day card.
interactions.feedback: Excellent planning! Different activities can happen on different days.
interactions.retryHint: Match one activity at a time. Use the day words on the cards.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Match each activity to the correct day.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an activity, then tap its day. You can change a match before checking.
interactions.feedback: You did it! You can relate activities to days of the week.
interactions.retryHint: Start with the school flag. Then match the weekend activities.
